feature-list.feature: 修复 4K / 2.5K 屏幕分辨率切换画面比例与裁剪异常：重排 vendor hwcomposer.msmnile.so 的 SetFrameBufferResolution 调用顺序至 SetActiveConfig 之前并移除异常回退分支（vendor_v13），彻底解决 1644×3840 与 1096×2560 切换后的显示放大/裁切问题
解除 4K 逻辑 UI 宽度限制：更新 FrameworkRes-Nagara-Overlay 的 config_maxUiWidth 为 0 并完善 SELinux 安全属性（product_v43），确保 4K 分辨率下界面渲染精度完整生效
系统版本更新至 64.2.A.3.73（system_v28）：经增量 OTA 同步下发 system、product 与 vendor 更新块，保留全部用户数据

operator-feature-list.feature: Fixed 4K / 2.5K Screen Resolution Scaling & Cropping: Patched vendor hwcomposer.msmnile.so (vendor_v13) to invoke SetFrameBufferResolution before SetActiveConfig and removed the revert hook, resolving distorted/cropped display scaling when switching between 1096×2560 and 1644×3840

Unlocked Full 4K Logical UI Width: Updated FrameworkRes-Nagara-Overlay (config_maxUiWidth=0 with preserved SELinux context in product_v43) so 4K mode renders at full logical UI width without 1096px clamping
System Version Bumped to 64.2.A.3.73 (system_v28): Incremental OTA seamlessly delivers system, product, and vendor deltas while preserving userdata
